reason: NONE. First thing I noticed was the $29.99 for 30 sachets, a dollar a day, when Nature Made or Double Wood run 20 to 40 cents. A brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal is not what I put in my body when my doctor told me to take magnesium.
objection: It is a dollar a serving from a brand nobody has reviewed, and a lab QR code is the company's own claim, not an NSF or USP seal I already trust. I'd stay with Pure Encapsulations, Thorne or Nature Made.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification, plus a few hundred real reviews, and a price closer to 50 or 60 cents a serving.
